description: A layout component used to create a horizontal group of columns with easy control over gap size and alignment.

props.align: Deprecated, use **align-\*** class. Available options are: **start**, **center**, **end**, **baseline** and **stretch**.
props.alignContent: Deprecated, use **align-content-\***. Available options are: **start**, **center**, **end**, **space-between**, **space-around** and **stretch**.
props.density: Adjusts the spacing between `v-col`s. Available options are: **default**, **comfortable**, **compact**.
props.justify: Deprecated, use **justify-\***. Available options are: **start**, **center**, **end**, **space-between** and **space-around**.
props.gap: Gap between columns, expects value in pixels. One value for both axes, or [column gap, row gap].
props.gapSm: Overrides **gap** from the **sm** breakpoint up, in pixels.
props.gapMd: Overrides **gap** from the **md** breakpoint up, in pixels.
props.gapLg: Overrides **gap** from the **lg** breakpoint up, in pixels.
props.gapXl: Overrides **gap** from the **xl** breakpoint up, in pixels.
props.gapXxl: Overrides **gap** from the **xxl** breakpoint up, in pixels.
